_provenance.source: ClinVar GRCh38 VCF release clinvar_20260905.vcf.gz (##fileDate=2026-09-05, md5 ece04fe2ee72db1dd988d8b188df34b9)
_provenance.how: bcftools view -h <url> for the header; bcftools view -H <url> <chrom>:<pos>-<pos> for the rows, keeping only the exact CHROM/POS/REF/ALT row of each public textbook variant
_provenance.note: Public textbook variants only. Decoy rows used by the tests are synthetic and live in tests/test_clinvar.py.
_provenance.header_note: `header` is the output of `bcftools view -h`: the 44 raw ## lines of the release plus the ##contig and ##FILTER=PASS lines htslib synthesises from the .tbi (the raw ClinVar VCF declares no contigs, so the retriever's chromosome spellings come from the index)
